summary: Ideal investment opportunity in the centre of Hartlepool. Located within walking distance to the town centre this property would attract a number of tenants ranging from single professionals to a small family and would achieve around £5700 per annum in rent. The property comprises of entrance vestibule, living room with fireplace, fitted kitchen with a range of units. To the first floor are two bedrooms one good size double and one large single, family bathroom with white suite. Yard to the rear, on street parking.
